ontology.Phi: effective response; x is its canonical natural-unit displacement
ontology.R_gen: derived, not a state or source

variable_meanings.x: canonical natural-unit response displacement, not a temperature
variable_meanings.I_chi: sum of the two charged thermal integrals f/(2E)
variable_meanings.J_i: partial I_i / partial mass_squared at fixed T and mu
variable_meanings.H_cubic: third derivative of shifted tree response potential, not the effective static Hessian
variable_meanings.static_response_curvature: Omega_xx at zero external frequency/momentum; not identified with a pole mass

equation_entries.derivation_origin: Tree polynomial plus thermal part of one-loop Bose determinant; independent action Hessian and thermal integral checks.
equation_entries.constant_origin: Declared synthetic action coefficients, no fit or experimental calibration.
equation_entries.observable: Stationary natural-unit response and thermodynamic derivatives; not SI temperature or heat conductivity.
equation_entries.claim_boundary: Thermal-only local normal stationary-background diagnostic; not full finite-T EOS, renormalized action, physical transport, SI alpha, or Full Topic 13 closure.

relation_or_code_path.weak_source_response: x_star approx G*I_chi(0)/[M0^2+6*lambda_response*I_response(0)+G^2*J_chi(0)] when the small-displacement expansion is controlled

equation_entries.standard_physics_counterpart: Gaussian thermal effective potential on a normal scalar background
